name: @juli-labs/artifacts
description: juli-os L2 layer: hash-registered deliverables with provenance. Zero npm dependencies — disk backend included, S3 presign hand-rolled.

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node22 --outfile=dist/index.js && esbuild bin/juli-artifacts.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node22 --outfile=dist/juli-artifacts.js && chmod +x dist/juli-artifacts.js && python3 scripts/postbuild.py
scripts.smoke:dist: node --input-type=module -e "import('./dist/index.js').then(async m => { const { join } = await import('node:path'); const { mkdtempSync } = await import('node:fs'); const { tmpdir } = await import('node:os'); const dir = mkdtempSync(join(tmpdir(), 'peel-d2-')); const b = m.createDiskBackend(join(dir, 's')); const { DatabaseSync } = await import('node:sqlite'); const l = m.createArtifactLedger(new DatabaseSync(join(dir, 'a.db')), b); const row = await l.putAndRegister({workflowId:'wf',role:'body',name:'x.md',bytes:Buffer.from('hi')}); if (!l.get(row.id)) process.exit(1); console.log('DIST SMOKE OK'); })"
